title: Elden Ring
description: The Lands Between, at the moment the Tarnished return. 114 characters, with The Scribe as your system admin.

welcome: Tarnished. Welcome to the Lands Between. I am the Scribe, and I keep this world's records.
Those you called are onstage, yet time stands still, so nothing is spent until you choose a speed at the top of the screen.
Send word to anyone from Chats, see where they wander in World, and read what has come to pass in Timeline.
Should you wish anything changed, tell me: a new character, a rewritten history, a place not yet on any map. Where shall we begin?

world.title: The Lands Between
world.summary: The Elden Ring is shattered, and grace is calling the Tarnished home.
